decisions.reason: Although submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the core range and only lightly presented on the website, it is very new and already backed by a multi-model line, so management is likely to continue rather than quickly reverse course.

The medical examination light builds on the firm's established lighting capabilities, was given its own page, and fits an expanding R&D-oriented company that is likely to justify and extend a recent launch.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires strongly match the firm's industrial customer base, strategic direction in advanced efficient lighting, and visible commitment through a dedicated multi-model line, making withdrawal unlikely.

The designer task light is close to the existing offer and publicly presented, so despite being somewhat less central to the firm's industrial and maritime emphasis, management would probably keep it on the market for longer.
